findings.suggested_fix:
P(hit) = 1 - exp(-10 lam / R) grows with the chord length, so the clipped centre and the gappy mid-radius come from the geometry, not from the artist's field. Make the gaps follow the field: normalise lam by the chord, or point-sample the density at the Cycles step positions instead of using the sheet mean. Then the lens image shows where the field is empty (the central keyhole) and the outer disc stays at the clamp.
Accept when, at p04-p06 open:
- the radial medians track F402 (about 237 / 235 / 252 / 254 / 253 / 252 over 0-0.86 R)
- the core clip (r < 0.5 R) is near 40 %
- the release (F453) shows gaps
- the band in front of the hidden orb is not dimmer than MAIN's
A Cycles flipbook of the artist's volume is still the frame-exact option.

regressions:
Nothing the lane made worse counts as a separate glitch. The one real trade belongs to F2 (major): in the open hold, the 0.5-0.86 R annulus of the orb, which MAIN matched to F402 within 1-6 L, is now 10-20 L below F402. The disc's global statistics still moved towards F402. H1 (the band in front of the hidden orb, -5..-6 L) is mixed against F420 and invisible at full frame, so it is listed as a nit.
Everything else holds:
- Far field: beyond 1.6 R with crystals masked, at most 0.15 % of pixels change by more than 2 L (max 15, crystal-edge AA) at any pose.
- Rest q00 / q03: orb identical within 0.02 L.
- Release p07 / p08: orb within 0.4 L of MAIN.
- Sweep (26 stills): no black or NaN pixels, no seams, no glitches.
- Pointer spots: no glitches.

- Real loop, second try (rtx2): hold paired mean-interval median 0.976 (5 pairs under load 10). Rest showed 1.096, from three vsync flips of 33 -> 50 ms at load 8.3-9.6.
- Rest-only re-check (rtx3, 8 pairs at load 5.8-7.4): 1.007 (pooled 1.016, block-median 1.000).

No regression above 5 %.
visual_verdict:
Round 3 moves the hold orb in the right direction but has not reached the reference.
What improved:
- MAIN's flat white plate is now a glowing ball with white plasma tongues and soft grey lens-image gaps.
- The pale glass edge with a lavender hairline replaces MAIN's dark rim line, which is much closer to F402.
- The brightest crystal facets reach the reference's level and stay periwinkle.
- Nothing glitches: the sweep, pointer spots, release, rest poses and the T0 / T2 tiers are clean, and flicker and frame time are unchanged.
What still differs side by side:
- F402 and the whole hold sheet F372-F418 show a bold, dark keyhole figure and bottom band inside a disc that is clipped white nearly to its edge. The lane shows the opposite: a clipped centre with faint pale wisps and a grey ring at mid-radius. At full frame the wisps are faint.
- Release (F453) and the eye pose (F045) keep MAIN's structureless core.
The orb's interior therefore remains the main gap for orb_shards_light (8.0) and awwwards_jury (7.9). Against the panel's build, the lane is a clear step up: no blue fresnel outline, translucent crystals, and a structured hold core. F2 stays open and major, so pass = false. Merging the lane would still improve MAIN on every judged lens.
